subject.title: fix: hot reload ACP runtime config

question: Should maintainers treat this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102212 as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102205?
rationale: Both open contributor PRs implement the same Gateway ACP reload-rule fix with positive evidence, and automation should not close or merge one solely from title similarity while both are still live candidates.

options.title: Use this PR as canonical
options.body: This PR is based on the reviewed current main SHA and includes an in-process config-write regression test in addition to the planner test.

options.title: Use the sibling PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102212 instead if maintainers prefer the issue reporter's smaller branch and production-stability narrative.

options.title: Ask for consolidation
options.body: Ask the contributors to coordinate and preserve the stronger proof/test coverage in one branch before landing.

recommendation.title: Use this PR as canonical
recommendation.body: This PR is based on the reviewed current main SHA and includes an in-process config-write regression test in addition to the planner test.

likelyOwner.reason: The current reload planner and adjacent Gateway/plugin lifecycle files were recently carried through this area by vincentkoc's merged refactor.
